answer_1.quote: We introduce a new text revision task of Controllable Debiasing, to help debias the portrayal of characters through the lens of connotation frames of power and agency.
answer_1.outputs: revised sentences with targeted agency and power connotations

answer_2.quote: In addition to human evaluations, we also use a variety of automated evaluation metrics to characterize different aspects of performance.
automatic_metrics: accuracy of the change in agency
fraction of output sentences with repeated bigrams (w/ rep)

answer_4.quote: To validate our automatic evaluations, we collect human judgments of the controllable revisions from several baselines and POWERTRANSFORMER (Joint+Boost). We design a head-to-head crowdsourcing task on Amazon Mechanical Turk where we ask raters to compare two outputs from different models given the same input sentence and target agency.
answer_4.guideline: We first ask them to judge whether either output is gibberish, then, in two questions, choose which revision has better targeted agency and which better preserves the meaning of the original sentence.
